dataset: City of Mississauga Building Report - Detail, August 2026
source_note: The City building-reports page currently links this file under the July 2026 detail-report label, while the PDF itself is headed August 2026 and shows run date 18 AUG 2026. Cases below follow the PDF content, not the link label.
purpose: Technical false-negative backtest only. These permit-positive public records are not market-validation E3 evidence.
privacy_note: Owner names and civic addresses from the public report are intentionally omitted. Permit numbers and summarized scopes remain for reproducibility against the official City report.

cases.scope_summary: Interior alteration of office/shipping office with structural reinforcement for a new rooftop unit.
Structural reinforcement of warehouse concrete slab for a crane, interior alteration of office area and a new exterior door.
New interior second-floor addition and change of use for a commercial studio project.
Interior alterations and a new interior second floor in an industrial building.
Demise one commercial unit into two units and complete a tenant fit-up in one of them.
Interior alterations that merge two existing commercial units.
